preanalysis_rationale: Likely related to baseline host/community variation and severe-pneumonia classification; individual-level linkage and timing require verification.
Potential baseline confounder; individual-level linkage requires verification.
May define or closely encode severity; routine adjustment could erase the clinical contrast. Verify exact role and measurement timing.
May be part of or downstream from acute severity; treat as overadjustment risk until definition/timing are verified.
Candidate baseline confounders, but the specific variables, coding, missingness, and linkage require verification.
Many may be downstream of acute illness; do not use a maximal adjustment set without causal rationale and timing.
Likely consequent to severity and/or treatment; adjusting can condition away the clinical contrast or induce selection bias.
May occur after presentation/severity assignment; timing, treatment definition, and pre-sampling status are required before any adjustment.
Clinically important if pre-BALF and pre-severity ascertainment; repository-level evidence does not establish individual timing or availability.
Single clinical center, so no site adjustment is estimable within this cohort.
Batch metadata are incomplete; possible technical confounding cannot be assessed.
